# Technology, Magic & Items

## A Mad Love {#a-mad-love}

A Mad Love is a newspaper story running to one hundred and three chapters that Captain Jim reads to see how long it can be spun out.

## Averil’s Atonement {#averil-s-atonement}

"Averil's Atonement" is a story written by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) that originally featured a sunset scene, which she removed prior to having the piece rejected by both an [American](../codex/factions.md#american) magazine editor and the editor of the [Canadian Woman](../codex/factions.md#canadian-woman).

## Four Sisters {#four-sisters}

The Four Sisters was a sea vessel that sailed to [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana) with [Dick](../character/dick.md) and [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) aboard, but failed to return from its return voyage, leading people to believe it was lost at sea.

## Virgil {#virgil}

Virgil is a dead language text assigned to students at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and studied by pupils to practice translation lines.
